property_summary: For any CashOut that succeeds (call to msg.sender returns true), the reference contract always appends a log entry (so the external Log helper's recorded call-count increases by exactly one), whereas the mutant omits that AddMessage and thus does not make that external call; therefore for some inputs the recorded call-count (or recorded last value) differs between reference and mutant.
change_summary: Replace the internal log call with a no-op (remove AddMessage) so side-effect ordering on balances remains but observable history differs.
